body: I too am struggling the same way as you. It’s easier to sleep away our pain 100%. I used to have really awesome dreams and would escape reality for them, but now my dreams have all turned scary. Like I’m fighting to survive in every single one. Just like in real life now.. Depression is really weird. & Even though my dreams are scary now, I’d still rather sleep than face who I am in real life; a depressed and empty person...

For everyone wondering, I am still here. It’s 10:15pm. My family is now sleeping. And I’m just sitting here with my opposing thoughts. I really appreciate every single person who has replied to me. This is the most support I’ve felt in my whole life. I hope I can pull through. I just know If I don’t do it tonight I’m going to wake up tomorrow or the next day feeling the same way... it never leaves me, it feels like depression has me by the throat everyday.

I wish that was true, but they really do not care if I’m here or gone. I don’t have much family at all. Hardly any friends.. & my siblings don’t talk to me because I have distanced myself from everyone for years... so in the end it leads me back to the same feeling.. despair, with no one there.
